faq.a: Sadig is associated with the Arabic form صَادِق, whose core sense is sadig; truthful, sincere (azerbaijani form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Sadig?
faq.a: Sadig is associated with Arabic. Sadig is the Azerbaijani form of Arabic صَادِق (Ṣādiq), meaning 'truthful, sincere'.
Yes — the underlying form صَادِق is Arabic.
Sadig can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Sadig should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ṣādiq is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Sadig mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Sadig is rendered صادق and carries the sense صادق، سچا.

faq.q: What does Sadig mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Sadig is rendered صادق and carries the sense صادق، راستگو.
A romanized syllable approximation is sa-dig. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Sadig?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Sadig, sadig. Script forms are صادق, صَادِق, सादिक़.

faq.q: Is Sadig a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
